author: @AliceQuitter
text:
Unfortunately, you're completely wrong about original-timeline Clem. Not only does that version also have superpowers, but her power is so great that she can stunlock the Keeper and every Awakener within a certain radius of her at-will. She's just as much of a disgusting space bug as playable Clem, and moreover, she's completely bought into the space bugs' plan to awaken Tohuwabohu, which is why she leads the invasion of Mythag in Chapter 8. The playable one had enough doubts to join the player's side.

Also, the awakening of Azathoth (AKA Tohuwabohu) causing all of reality to cease goes all the way back to the original Lovecraft stories, which is why the flautists play their reedy pipes endlessly to keep It asleep. Elder Scrolls stole that from the mythos.
